scope: Primary-source research; recommendations are Cubey-specific inferences, not measured candidate results

sources.title: NVIDIA Omniverse path tracing - Firefly Filtering
sources.supports: Production HDR ray-intensity caps for glossy/diffuse paths; energy-loss tradeoff is explicit.

sources.title: RTXPT IntroPathTracer FireflyClamp
sources.supports: Hue-preserving cap on throughput-weighted per-deposit HDR contributions before accumulation.

sources.title: RTXPT Design.md
sources.supports: Separate pure-specular tracing and path layers provide inputs for reconstruction; dominant-layer depth/motion and blended material guides.

sources.title: RTXPT Intro Sample reference mode
sources.supports: The accumulating learning reference is itself clamped and approximates transport; distinguish it from ground truth.

sources.title: NRD integration guidance
sources.supports: Surface-guide requirements, transparency limitations, primary surface replacement and anti-firefly support.

sources.title: Intel Open Image Denoise - RT filter and auxiliary inputs
sources.supports: HDR beauty input can be denoised with optional albedo/normal guides; perfect-glass guides can follow/blend secondary paths.

sources.title: PBRT 4e - A Better Path Tracer
sources.supports: Solar/specular variance and regularization after a non-specular event; pure-delta prefixes are deliberately excluded.

sources.title: PBRT 3e - Whitted integrator
sources.supports: Deterministically summing reflected and transmitted specular branches; cost grows with the branch tree.

sources.title: EARS: Efficiency-Aware Russian Roulette and Splitting
sources.supports: Sampling allocation balances variance reduction against tracing cost.
sources.read_scope: Author/institution abstract and evaluation page; full 32 MB PDF exceeded web-tool size.

sources.title: Tracing Ray Differentials
sources.supports: Propagate an image-plane footprint through ray transport to guide filtering; not a complete glass/sun filter.

sources.title: Improved Shader and Texture Level of Detail Using Ray Cones
sources.supports: Practical GPU footprint/LOD machinery; texture filtering alone does not filter our separate solar test.

sources.title: Path-space motion estimation and decomposition for robust animation filtering
sources.supports: Different reflected/refracted components benefit from distinct guides and motion estimates.

sources.title: Specular Manifold Sampling for Rendering High-Frequency Caustics and Glints
sources.supports: Solve connections through specular chains rather than finding them only by chance; larger integration effort.
